_source: Derived from offers.md §9 (Key Problem taxonomy), customer-language.md §1 (personas) and §6b (content engines), entity-record.md §10 (owned terminology). Live-post evidence from www.gethelium.co/blogs sitemap, GSC 90d pull 2026-08-26.
_rule: Gate 1 fails any draft whose primary keyword does not map to exactly one cluster and at least one persona.

clusters.notes: The only cluster where naming a competing tool is on-brand. brand-voice.md §8: name the category, draw the line, never attack a named competitor's brand.

clusters.name: India festive and seasonal playbooks

audience_guard.reason: Measured failure. /blogs/d2c-apparel-calendar-2026 drew 1,511 impressions in 28 days at position 7.3 for 5 clicks, because it ranks for consumer retail-sale queries, not operator queries. GSC 90d, 2026-08-26.
audience_guard.rule: A draft in this cluster must target the brand-side operator ('how should my brand plan for X'), never the shopper side ('when is X sale'). Gate 1 fails the draft if the title or H1 matches a negative_intent term.

clusters.notes: Strongest local moat and highest volume, but the only cluster with a demonstrated wrong-audience failure mode. Treat the guard as mandatory.

excluded_keywords.reason: SERP is helium the chemical element — Cleveland Clinic, American Physical Society, helium canister retailers. The keyword sheet itself records an entity-intent mismatch.
SERP belongs to a different company (ai.helium.com, he2.ai, iOS/Android apps). 1,334 impressions at position 4.1 in GSC are Helium being found despite the collision, not because of ranking strategy.
excluded_keywords.action: never target as a blog primary keyword; belongs to brand/entity work, not content
